blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine peso’s record slide continued on Monday as markets focused on the upcoming US Federal Reserve meeting. The local currency fell to an intraday low of 63.8 as of 9:33 a.m. after it opened at 63.535, data from the Bankers Association of the Philippines showed. READ: Peso logs fresh record low of 63.615:$1 This surpassed the previous record low of 63.62.
